01

Monster Loot System

Drops, average prices, and hunting locations

Creature loot is organized by monster family so players can compare common drops, average value, and where the creatures are found.

Monsters that provide over 20 base experience can also drop Gold Nuggets and Archlight Tokens. These do not need to be added to the autoloot list.

TopicDetailsNotes
Monster DropsLoot entries are split into readable item tags so long rows remain scannable.Loot List
